patch_description: This design draws on Gen 2's constant-velocity adaptive Kalman filter (excellent lag/accuracy) and Gen 3's capped NIS insight. Key changes: (1) process-noise inflation from normalized innovation squared is capped at ~4× the baseline (Gen 2 let Q explode 50×, causing 304 slope changes; Gen 9's uncapped variant showed the same failure); (2) a trend-lock/hysteresis mechanism on the velocity state: the estimated slope is only allowed to flip sign if it exceeds a noise-derived significance threshold (multiplied by an online estimate of slope uncertainty), directly attacking false reversals and slope churn; (3) velocity is shrunk toward its EMA in low-innovation regimes so noise cannot leak into the slope state; (4) a light 3-tap post-smoother (Gen current's trick) further suppresses spurious reversals with negligible phase delay. The output contract (len(x) - window_size + 1, warmup on first window-1 samples) is preserved exactly.
